Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a targeted in situ cross-linking mass spectrometry (XL-MS) study. While it uses affinity purification (Strep-tag) to reduce complexity, it is not a standard AP-MS for interactomics but specifically for structural cross-link identification. The base workflow is DDA LFQ. No specific PTM modifiers from the provided ontology list (like phospho or ubiquitin) were used; instead, chemical cross-linkers (DSS, BS3, Formaldehyde) were employed.

The 'treatment' is the genetic introduction of these proteins. The cross-linkers are reagents for the assay rather than biological perturbations, but are listed as agents for completeness of the MS-analyzed sample context.
